newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav Jan producer prices up 1.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav Jan producer prices up 1.9 pct.

text.p: The Federal Statistical Office reported the following economic indicator details on Tuesday.
NOTES -- January producer prices rose 15.6 percent against the 1996 average.
The average 1996 PPI index rose 90.1 percent against the 1995 average.
Data refer to Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro.

National Bank of Yugoslavia imposed a stabilisation programme on January 24, 1994, when retail price inflation was running at a monthly 313 million percent. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
